en: "...By the way, that brat's... No, I'll find the kid myself.{w}...It's a matter of settling up. This is payment for the trouble.{w}Only one parent, same as me, and yet nothing like me..."{w}{p}"But don't think I'm going straight now.{w}I'm a thief till the day I die. That's who I am.{w}So I'll settle up with loot from a job, too."{w}{p}"And next time we meet, I'll kill you lot too.{w}Don't come to the hideout again."{w}
note: Brassel keeps the Soleil Stone (row 238) as amends for the blond kid from Roscadil (rows 229-233). "the brat"/"the kid" kept gender-neutral. "kataoya da tte no ni, ore to wa oochigai" read with row 233: the kid also has one parent, yet turned out nothing like Brassel ("same as me" is an inference from that contrast -- flag).

en: Certain NPCs join your adventure in the summoned-monster slot.{w}{p}If a similar NPC is already with you, another one cannot be added.{w}{p}Either finish the event of the NPC currently with you, or disband your party once at the tavern.{w}
note: System help text.

en: "Oh, it's you guys again!"{w}
"How's it going?"
note: Menu choice.

en: Talk
note: Menu choice.

en: "Electra, come on, let's get going!"{w}
"Wait, I haven't introduced everyone yet.{w}This is Mig.{w}A unicorn, as you can see."{w}{p}"Mig and I have been together since birth,{w}and Mig travels with me like this.{w}And..........."{w}
note: Mig's gender not in glossary: repeated the name instead of a pronoun. "umareta toki kara" is unclear whose birth -- "since birth" keeps it open. Trailing "And..." is cut off by Yamuru.

en: "Yamuru. I'm a bounty hunter.{w}I hear the Proclamation pays a pretty good sum,{w}so I've been let in on this party."{w}
note: Source has the variant spelling of the Proclamation term; used glossary "the Proclamation".

en: "I'm Maniron~! Nice ta meetcha~!"{w}
note: Childish sing-song voice.

en: "My name is Korbitz.{w}We may end up relying on each other from here on,{w}so let's look out for one another, eh?"{w}
Mokero
note: Name box.

en: "The name's Mokero, it is!{w}The Miss has done a whole heap for me,{w}and I'll be followin' the Miss for the rest o' my days!"{w}
note: "Ojou" rendered "the Miss" (Mokero's fixed address for Electra). The source word itself is feminine; this is a translation of the title, not an inferred gender, but flagged since Electra is "unknown" in the glossary. Mokero's humble-roughneck "asshi ... yasu" speech -> dropped g's and "it is!/I will!" tags.

en:
"Mokero, I keep telling you,
you don't have to be so formal..."{w}
"Miss! Don't go sayin' such cold things!{w}The debt I owe you, Miss, is............"{w}
note: Trails off; cut short by Korbitz.

en: "Electra's a kind child, you see,{w}took us in, just like this.{w}So please, all of you, be good to Electra."{w}
note: Repeated the name instead of a pronoun.

en: "Ugh, honestly! You're all exaggerating!{w}If someone's in trouble, I help them.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 256 re-shows this text inside {0E}..{0F} and finishes it.
{0E}..{0F} part mirrors row 255 word for word.

en: "Me too, y'know~ Electra once~"{w}
note: Maniron starts to say Electra helped them too and is cut off by Electra (row 258). Kept as a fragment.

en: "Okay, okay, I get it!{w}Anyway, that's how it is, so be nice to all of us, okay?"{w}

"By the way... yours looks
like a pretty decent party."{w}
note: Yamuru to the player party.

en:
"We might end up competing with each other in all kinds of ways.{w}What do you say? How about you lot
and us have a little test of skill?"{w}
"Hey, Yamuru!"{w}
"These are the people who'll be our rivals from here on.{w}We need to see what they can do now, don't we?"{w}
"Well, that's..."{w}
"Besides, you need the bounty money, right?{w}Or was this something you started half-heartedly?"{w}
note: Yamuru to Electra.

en:
"Electra, what'll we do?
If you're going to fight, I'll help, okay?"{w}
"............Okay, I've made up my mind!"{w}{p}"You guys, let's have a match!{w}All right, everyone, let's go!!"{w}
"Ooh~ I'm gonna lop off some heads~!"{w}
note: Maniron (ninja-style beheading joke, cf. slice_05 rows 329-330).

en: Leave
note: Menu choice (30 dupes).

en: You sent Electra's party packing.{w}
note: Narration after the battle (30 dupes); subject = player party.

en: "Ow ow ow...{w}You guys are amazing..."{w}
"Not bad at all.{w}Still, Electra,{w}your alchemy spells are as half-baked as ever."{w}
note: Added "Electra" as the addressee: Mig answers this at row 274 by reassuring Electra.

en: "I wanted a Bulafei~~!"{w}
note: NEW NAME: Bluffy = alchemy spell (SPELL.CSV row 64: hides one ally from enemy targeting). Maniron wanted Electra to cast it on them; Electra's reply (row 273) settles it.

en: "Th-then go hide yourself!"{w}

"It's okay, Electra!
Your alchemy spells will get better from here on!"{w}
"Th... thank you, Mig..."{w}
"It's all right,{w}there's no need to rush."{w}
"I'll be lendin' a hand too, I will!"{w}
"Everyone... thank you.{w}Okay, so that's how it is,{w}next time I'll be able to do a lot more!"{w}{p}"See you!"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
note: Narration (30 dupes).
Menu choice (silent option).

en: Talk to them
note: Menu choice (24 dupes).

en: "Look, alchemy spells and Rangers go well together.{w}But if your success rate's low, it's pointless."{w}
note: NEW TERM: kariudo (class) -> "Hunter"; check against the class list once UI is translated (an earlier English Elminage release may have used "Ranger").

en: "I know that already!{w}That's why I'm studying like this, okay!?"{w}
"Don't be so hard on the Miss!{w}I'll be pitchin' in too, I will!"{w}
"Maniron's gonna try hard too~!"{w}
note: Maniron refers to self by name in the source.

en: "That's right, Electra!{w}You mustn't live a life where you bend your convictions!{w}You can still do it! Hang in there!"{w}
"You're right... I'll try a little harder!"{w}
"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 289 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{0F}
Oh?"{w}
note: Korbitz notices the player party.

en: "Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 291 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{0F}
How's it going? Things are going great for us!"{w}
"Come to think of it, you got the better of us last time.{w}It won't go that way this time, got it?"{w}
"Yamuru, you're more hot-blooded than you look.{w}Didn't you have a rule about never doing anything that doesn't pay?"{w}
"There's something I want to check..."{w}
"I'll be showin' what I'm made of too!"{w}
"Chop-chop, off with their heads~~~!"{w}
"Hm? Fine by me, but...?{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 298 re-shows it (source drops the "?" there, mirrored).

en:
{0E}"Hm? Fine by me, but...{0F}
Okay, everyone, let's go!"{w}
"...Just as I thought."{w}
note: What Yamuru wanted to check (row 294) is never stated here; left vague.

en: "What's wrong?"{w}
"No, it's nothing.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 302 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"No, it's nothing.{0F}
You lot look like a pretty good party."{w}

"Well, it's parties like ours, with a unicorn,
that are the rare ones, y'know."{w}
note: Maniron cuts in on Yamuru's praise of the player party: having a unicorn makes their own party the special one.

en: "Having me around is proof of Innocence, after all!"{w}
note: "Innocent" capitalised to keep the link with the Innocent series / never-changed-class idea (pilot row 33; Mig taunts Yamuru as a class-changer in slice_05 row 343). Whose innocence is left open, as in the source.

en: "Yeah, yeah, you're absolutely right."{w}
"Miss! It's about time we..."{w}
"You're right.{w}
note: Unclosed quote as in source; row 308 re-shows it.

en:
{0E}"You're right.{0F}
We won't lose next time, you hear? See you!"{w}

note: Menu choice.

en: "But I really do need to study...{w}Even you can read and write, right, Yamuru?"{w}

"That's a harsh way to put it.
What good is a bounty hunter who can't read a wanted poster?"{w}

"I can't read, but
it's never been a problem, y'know?"{w}
"I'll teach you, then.{w}Perhaps we'll hold a little study session one of these days, hm?"{w}
"I hate studyyying..."{w}
"But what about textbooks... and the money for them?"{w}
"Oh, we'll manage somehow."{w}
"Electra, Electra, look!"{w}
"Oh! You again, in a place like this!"{w}
"We must share quite the bond of fate, eh?"{w}
